bund.name: The Bund
bund.hours: Open 24 hours · best lit after dark
bund.tip: Walk the 1.5 km promenade from south to north at dusk for the Pudong skyline lighting up.
bund.best: Sunset into evening; avoid weekend crowds

yugarden.name: Yu Garden
yugarden.price_text: ≈ CNY 30–40 garden entry; check on the day
yugarden.tip: Come at opening to beat tour groups, then browse the bazaar outside.

pearltower.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
pearltower.price_text: ≈ CNY 160–260 depending on deck; check on the day
pearltower.tip: Book online and go on a clear day; haze can hide the view.
pearltower.best: Late afternoon for daylight and night views

shanghaitower.name: Shanghai Tower
shanghaitower.price_text: ≈ CNY 180 observation deck; check on the day
shanghaitower.tip: The 118th-floor deck is the highest in China; check visibility before buying.

nanjingroad.name: Nanjing Road
nanjingroad.tip: Walk the pedestrian stretch from People's Square toward the Bund in the evening.

peoplessquare.name: People's Square
peoplessquare.tip: A central green space and metro hub; use it as a base between sights.

shanghaimuseum.name: Shanghai Museum
shanghaimuseum.tip: Book a free timed slot online; the bronze and ceramics galleries are the highlights.

xintiandi.name: Xintiandi
xintiandi.price_text: Free to walk · cafés and bars extra
xintiandi.tip: Restored shikumen lanes; good for an evening drink and people-watching.

swfc.name: Shanghai World Financial Center
swfc.price_text: ≈ CNY 150–180 observation deck; check on the day
swfc.tip: The 'bottle opener' tower; the 100th-floor walkway has glass floor panels.

aunteajenny.name: Auntea Jenny
aunteajenny.hours: Branches roughly 10:00–22:00 · check on the day
aunteajenny.tip: Popular local milk-tea chain; order at the counter or via the app and expect a short queue.

frenchconcession.name: French Concession
frenchconcession.tip: Wander the plane-tree streets around Wukang Road and Anfu Road for cafés and old villas.

fudan.name: Fudan University
fudan.hours: Campus roughly 08:00–17:00 · check entry rules on the day
fudan.tip: A leafy campus in Yangpu; bring ID and check whether visitors can enter.

huangpucruise.name: Huangpu River Cruise
huangpucruise.price_text: ≈ CNY 100–150 for a short night cruise; check on the day
huangpucruise.hours: Departures roughly from late afternoon to 21:00
huangpucruise.tip: Take a night sailing to see both banks lit up; buy at the Bund piers.

jingantemple.name: Jing'an Temple
jingantemple.price_text: ≈ CNY 50 entry; check on the day
jingantemple.tip: A gold-roofed Buddhist temple among skyscrapers; visit in the morning when quieter.

jinjiangactionpark.name: Jinjiang Action Park (Jinjiang Leyuan)
jinjiangactionpark.price_text: ≈ CNY 150–250 day pass; check on the day
jinjiangactionpark.tip: A large amusement park in Minhang; check ride closures and weather first.

legoland.name: Legoland Shanghai
legoland.price_text: ≈ CNY 300–450 day ticket; check on the day
legoland.tip: Far southwest in Jinshan; plan a full day and book tickets online.

newyobo.name: NewYobo
newyobo.tip: Confirm the current address and opening hours before you go.

disneyland.name: Shanghai Disneyland
disneyland.price_text: ≈ CNY 400–600 depending on date; check on the day
disneyland.tip: Book online, arrive at opening, and use the metro line 11 to avoid traffic.

grandtheatre.name: Shanghai Grand Theatre
grandtheatre.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–800 depending on show; check on the day
grandtheatre.hours: Box office roughly 10:00–19:00 · show times vary
grandtheatre.tip: Check the programme for ballet, opera or theatre and book ahead for weekends.

haichangocean.name: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park
haichangocean.tip: Far southeast near the coast; a full-day trip with kids, book online.

sjtu.name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
sjtu.hours: Campus roughly 08:00–17:00 · check entry rules on the day
sjtu.tip: The Xuhui campus has historic buildings; bring ID and check visitor access.

oceanaquarium.name: Shanghai Ocean Aquarium
oceanaquarium.tip: Next to the Oriental Pearl Tower; go early to avoid school groups.

wetmarket.name: Wet market food walk (French Concession)
wetmarket.price_text: ≈ CNY 100–200 for tastings; check on the day
wetmarket.tip: Go early with an empty stomach; small stalls may be cash or app payment only.

skyviewpoint.name: Rooftop bar viewpoint over the Bund
skyviewpoint.price_text: ≈ CNY 80–150 minimum spend on a drink
skyviewpoint.tip: Book a table for sunset; dress smart and confirm the minimum spend.

wukangwalk.name: Wukang Road neighbourhood walk
wukangwalk.tip: A self-guided loop past the Wukang Mansion and leafy lanes; go on a weekday to avoid crowds.

suzhoucreek.name: Suzhou Creek walk
suzhoucreek.tip: Walk the creekside path toward the Bund for bridges and old warehouses.

tianzifang.name: Tianzifang lanes
tianzifang.tip: A maze of shikumen alleys with small shops; good for a short wander and coffee.

circus.name: Acrobatics show (Shanghai Circus World)
circus.price_text: ≈ CNY 180–400 depending on seat; check on the day
circus.hours: Evening shows, usually around 19:30 · check schedule
circus.tip: Book seats in advance and arrive early; shows are family-friendly.
